note: Both contracts are Arbitrum Stylus programs (Rust → WASM): deployed with `cargo stylus deploy` and activated via activateProgram, so Arbiscan labels them "Stylus Contract". Run `cargo stylus verify` in each crate to publish the Rust source against these addresses. Authorize the verifier to mint with `node scripts/chain-admin.mjs set-issuer <registry> <verifier>` — the registry constructor received the deployer EOA as its initial issuer, so until that call is made every verify_and_issue reverts Unauthorized at the registry.
